author: Widogeist
body: It seems to fall off randomly like standard temp buffs; I've seen it last for 2-3 turns in one fight, and in another fight it lasted 10+ turns. They've literally never casted the towering buff prior to maintenance yesterday, now they do it multiple times per battle. If you have access to ultima/ultima 2/ultimastrikes it makes quick work of the Titans though. Also, Prometheus can be petrified and Eos can be slept, and stasis works on *all* the titans.

author: Tavmania
body:
Prometheus is weak to the Rot, Poison and Blight status effects. Ailments have a massive effect on keeping his regen down. Better yet, stacking all 3 possibly out-performs his health regeneration. He also has a weakness to Ice, which you aren't taking advantage of. It looks to me like you're using Arisen Nagamaki - he's immune to bleed unfortunately.     

Since you are wearing Realm Strikes, I assume you are a Realmshifter. Ideally, you would wear a weapon that is imbued through the skill Ice Affinity to maximize damage.   

Depending on how frustrated you are with this fight, it might be possible to use another weapon for this fight that is imbued with earth element while you spam Icestrike III. That way, you don't have to resort to using Earthstrike III or something similar for inflcting Rot. (I could use a physical player to confirm this, I haven't played as a thief in a while)  

Last question: why are you not redlining as a thief? Perhaps you're a Deity just relying on reducing MP for stat boosts? I think physical Deities are struggling much harder to make the most out of raid-types of fights, so I'm not surprised that Deity classes have difficulties with this fight.   

For sub-245 mages reading this comment: Iced Earth II with an occasional Miasma in between makes short work of him.
